svg.title: A language model scores—and generates—one token at a time
svg.desc: A language model assigns probabilities to whole token sequences and generates by sampling a next token from the distribution conditioned on the current context. The example contrasts an ordered sentence with a shuffled one and shows a next-token distribution.
